scope: Synthetic research only; no human calibration, CEFR validity, or production scoring change.

methods.interval: Wilson 95% marginal binomial intervals per participant, per domain or any-domain indicator; not simultaneous intervals; no pooled-domain independence assumption.

blueprint.selection: highest core cell with >=4/6 correct, else A1; one confirmation block; fixed endpoint, no retest or optional stopping

policies.editorial_endpoint: At completed endpoint: n>=3, correct>=3, fraction>=.75 at each level; select highest supported.
policies.independent_binomial: Same editorial gate plus exact upper-tail Binomial(n,.25) <= .01/(5 levels * 3 domains * 2 possible endpoints); independence assumption required.
policies.block_conservative: Same raw editorial gate plus Binomial(number of independent stimulus blocks,.25) tail for all-correct blocks <= .01/30; arbitrary within-block dependence allowed, between-block independence required.

methods.syntheticItems: Mathematical response placeholders with intended level and stimulus-group identity; no actual language content and no empirically estimated item parameters.
methods.dependence: Within a passage, probability rho uses one shared Bernoulli(p); otherwise items are independent Bernoulli(p). This preserves marginal p and gives within-block ICC rho. Different passages independent. Language items independent.
methods.nullDistinction: Candidate dependent-null scenarios have marginal success .25 but are NOT independent uniform option guessing; they deliberately stress binomial misspecification.
methods.nominalTargets: Assumed secure boundaries chosen for sensitivity exercises, not observed learner truth. The emerging-B1 profile is nominally A2 with B1 probability .70.

currentEngine.endpoint: completed full 30-item attempt only; no interim reporting or early stopping
